lines.trans: What happened, do we have problems?
Vitya, you do not have to resign at all.
Did you feel sorry for me?
I felt sorry for myself, if I fire you Katya will nag me to death.
Stay at the restaurant.
Stay with my menu?
Only let's do this without conditions, alright?
Elya, I am in my fifties.
This menu is my last chance to get a star.
Either I stay with my menu, or both my menu and I leave.
Alright, stay.
On Saturday we are going to meet my mom.
